title: Ramp button
description: Flat, small-radius buttons at one weight: an acid-lime primary, a near-black solid, a warm light-grey secondary, a frosted glass pill for media, and a hushed text link whose arrow nudges right on hover. Colour changes ease over 0.3s.
notes: glass is meant for photo or video backdrops
link is the 'Read more →' style used under headings
name: ramp-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: acid-lime fill · solid: near-black fill · secondary: warm light-grey fill ·
glass: frosted pill with a play icon, for media · link: hushed text with a trailing arrow

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 35px tall (header) · md: 43px tall (sections) · lg: 50px tall (banners)

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link (e.g. "submit" inside a form)
